label: GO step after a rewarded rare transition a2->S1 (earlier in the episode)
explanation: Fires only at GO steps, and only when the previous trial was rewarded (in_rew=1 shown at D1). It never fires at D1 or D2. The core case is a previous trial where the agent chose a2, made a rare transition to S1 and was rewarded: every active step in the rare-rewarded group had prev_action a2. That is evidence for S1 being good, so a model-based agent should switch to a1. The feature fades over the episode: it is strongest in trials 0-49, rare after trial 70 and absent after trial 80, so the predicate keeps ep_trial < 70. That raises precision from 0.50 to 0.72 for dev F1 0.63 and mass recall 0.66. The missed activations, about a third of the mass, are mostly weak (lowest quartile) and come at GO after a rewarded common a1->S1 trial early in the episode. So the broader theme is a rewarded visit to S1, and the a2->S1 rare case drives it hardest: top-quartile coverage is 0.78. A version using only prev_state==1 & prev_reward==1 has recall 0.80 but precision 0.12. It does not fire after unrewarded trials, after rewards in S2, or outside GO. It uses only observed history.
